notes: family: running-track. Official rulebook PDF could not be retrieved (publisher link dead, Scribd paywalled), so only the high-level rule from reviews is modelled: three years, most Rep wins; gold-label specialty recipes give bonus Rep earned in play. Exact end-of-game bonuses and tiebreaker not verified. Do not confuse with the Travel Card Game (ends at 21 Rep).
